questions.question: With whom did David commit adultery?
What did David do to Bathsheba's husband, Uriah?
options: Sent him into exile far from Israel
Rewarded him with land and silver
Arranged for him to be killed in battle
Promoted him to command the army
questions.answer: Arranged for him to be killed in battle

questions.question: Uriah the Hittite was one of David's loyal soldiers.
